change_summary: Add only the four preregistered checksum-valid Kraken depth-10 H3 orderbook state features as raw prospective context on XBT/ETH/SOL eligible V2R4 candidates. No threshold, transform, score weight, pair ranking, model, entry/exit/risk mechanic, candidate discovery or active V2R4 behavior is changed.

evidence_plan.minimum_gate: >=20 eligible matched XBT/ETH/SOL candidates across >=2 distinct UTC dates AND >=95% H3 point-in-time context capture.
evidence_plan.low_impact_rule: If <3 causal H3 decision divergences at minimum gate, classify INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_IMPACT and do not tune or auto-extend.
evidence_plan.baseline_replay_stability_gate: Causal divergence counts only when same-snapshot control replay matches the official V2R4 baseline decision.

promotion_gate.rule: Pilot evidence proceeds only to human project review. Any later promotion requires separate prospective incremental-value review after costs and separate release approval.
